capability: Browser download and clipboard export (shared technical module)
description: Shared technical module, not a business domain. Delivers user data out of the browser: direct and blob file downloads, Content-Disposition filename extraction, cloud fetch-as-blob downloads, opening files in a new tab, and clipboard copy with success and failure toasts. Feature-specific export payloads (asset zips, node outputs, workflows, system info) stay with their owning domains.

characterizationScenarios.name: Downloads resolve filenames, stream via blob on cloud, and open files in new tabs safely
Clipboard copy falls back to the legacy path and toasts success or failure

compatibilityPromises: Inventory preserves existing exports and runtime behavior without granting public entry points or cross-module dependency permissions.
